tei:div.tei:p:
Exult, O righteous ones, in the Lord, it is becoming to the upright to give praise. Thank the Lord with the zither, with the ten-stringed harp make music to Him. Sing to Him a new song, pluck the strings well in triumph. For upright is the word of the Lord and all His work is with faithfulness. He loves righteousness and justice, the grace of the Lord fills the earth. Through the word of the Lord were the heavens made and through the breath of His mouth all their host. He gathers like a heap the waters of the seas, and puts the depths into store-chambers. The whole earth is afraid before the Lord, before Him do all inhabitants of the world tremble. For He spoke and it was, He commanded and there it stood. The Lord has frustrated the plan of nations, baffled the thoughts of peoples. The counsel of the Lord endures for ever, the thoughts of His heart from generation to generation. Fortunate the nation whose God is the Lord, the people which He has chosen as His inheritance. The Lord has looked from heaven, He has seen all the sons of man. From His dwelling place does He watch over all the inhabitants of the earth. He who has formed their hearts altogether, He understands all their deeds. The king is not saved by the size of an army, the warrior will not escape through the measure of strength. Useless is the horse for victory, by the measure of its might
it will not save. Behold, the eye of the Lord is towards those who fear Him, those who wait for His grace. To save their soul from death and to keep them alive in famine. Our soul has waited for the Lord, He is our help and our shield. In Him will our heart rejoice, for in His holy Name do we trust. May Thy grace be upon us, O Lord, since we have waited for Thee.
